blocks.text: O'zbek tilida savol yasash uchun so'z tartibi o'zgarmaydi — kesimga `-mi` qo'shiladi: «Siz talabasiz» → «Siz talaba**mi**siz?». Ingliz tilida esa savol **so'z tartibi** bilan yasaladi: **be** fe'li (am / is / are) egadan **oldinga** chiqadi. You **are** ready → **Are** you ready? She **is** at home → **Is** she at home? Shu o'rin almashish o'zbekchadagi `-mi` vazifasini bajaradi. Yozuvda gap oxirida so'roq belgisi (?) qo'yiladi, og'zaki nutqda esa ohang ko'tariladi.

Ega uzun bo'lsa ham qoida o'zgarmaydi: **be** butun eganing oldiga chiqadi. Your brother **is** in London → **Is** your brother in London? The shops **are** open → **Are** the shops open? Ega (your brother, the shops) bo'linmaydi — fe'l uning oldiga yaxlit o'tadi. Shuning uchun avval egani toping, keyin **be** ni uning oldiga qo'ying.
Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

Savolga faqat «Yes» yoki «No» deb javob berish quruq va biroz qo'pol eshitiladi. Odatda **qisqa javob** beriladi: Yes / No + olmosh + am / is / are. Savoldagi fe'l javobda takrorlanadi: **Are** you ...? — Yes, I **am**. **Is** it ...? — No, it **isn't**. Javobda ot emas, olmosh ishlatiladi: Is your brother at home? — Yes, **he** is («Yes, your brother is» deyilmaydi). O'zbekchada ham shunga o'xshash: «Uydami? — Ha, uyda.»

Ijobiy qisqa javobda **qisqa shakl ishlatilmaydi**: «Yes, I'm.», «Yes, it's.», «Yes, they're.» — xato. To'g'risi: **Yes, I am.** **Yes, it is.** **Yes, they are.** Sababi: gap oxirida urg'u fe'lga tushadi, qisqargan shakl esa urg'usiz bo'ladi. Inkor javobda qisqa shakl odatiy: **No, I'm not.** **No, it isn't.**

**Are you ...?** savoliga javob vaziyatga bog'liq, chunki **you** ham birlik, ham ko'plik. Bitta odamdan so'ralsa — **I am**, sizdan va yoningizdagilardan so'ralsa — **we are**: Are you ready, Aziz? — Yes, I am. / Are you and Tom brothers? — Yes, we are.

items.text: Is the bank open now? — No, **it isn't**.
Are your parents at home? — Yes, **they are**.

blocks.text: So'roq so'zlari: what, where, who, how ...

Javob «ha / yo'q» emas, balki ma'lumot bo'lsa, savol **so'roq so'zi** bilan boshlanadi. Tartib: so'roq so'zi + **be** + ega. O'zbekchada so'roq so'zi odatda kesim o'rnida turadi («Kalitlar **qayerda**?»), inglizchada esa doim **gap boshida**: **Where** are the keys? So'zlashuvda **is** qisqaradi: **where's**, **what's**, **who's**, **how's**. **are** esa yozuvda odatda qisqartirilmaydi: Where **are** you?

rows: **How old is** your son? — O'g'lingiz necha yoshda?
**How much is** this bag? — Bu sumka qancha turadi?
**What colour is** your car? — Mashinangiz qanaqa rangda?
**What time is** the train? — Poyezd soat nechada?

blocks.text: Predlog gap oxirida: Where are you from?

O'zbekchada «Qayerdansiz?» — bitta so'z: `-dan` qo'shimchasi so'roq so'zining o'ziga qo'shiladi. Inglizchada esa **from** («-dan») savolning **oxirida** qoladi: **Where** are you **from**? Shunday savollar ko'p: **Who** is this present **for**? (Bu sovg'a kim uchun?), **What** is this book **about**? (Bu kitob nima haqida?). Predlogni gap boshiga chiqarish («From where are you?») — xato.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «You are student?» → **Are you a student?** (so'z tartibi va `a`); «Where you are from?» → **Where are you from?**; «How old you are?» → **How old are you?**; «How many years are you?» → **How old are you?**; «Is cold?» → **Is it cold?** (ega tushib qolmaydi); «Yes, I'm.» → **Yes, I am.**

Eslab qolish: savolda **be** egadan **oldinga sakraydi**: you are → **are you**? So'roq so'zi bo'lsa, u undan ham oldinda: **Where** + **are** + **you**? Javobda esa tartib yana odatdagidek: I **am** ..., It **is** ...

Xuddi shu tartib boshqa zamonlarda ham ishlaydi: **Are** you working? (Present Continuous savoli — 4-dars), **Was** she at home? (10-dars). **do / does** bilan savollar — 7-dars. So'roq so'zlari batafsil — 44–47-darslar.

examples.title: Yes/no questions with **am / is / are**
examples.description: Ha / yo'q savoli: **be** fe'li egadan oldinga chiqadi. You are → **Are** you ...? It is → **Is** it ...? Bu o'zbekchadagi `-mi` qo'shimchasining o'rnida.

sentences.text: **Are** you a student?
**Is** this seat free?
Excuse me, **is** this the bus to Chorsu?
**Is** your brother at school today?
**Are** the shops open on Sunday?
Aziz, **are** you ready? The taxi is here.
**Am** I late for the meeting?
Mum, **are** my football boots in the car?
**Is** Oxford far from London?
Tell me honestly, **is** this dress too short?

examples.title: Short answers: **Yes, I am.** / **No, it isn't.**
examples.description: Qisqa javob: Yes / No + olmosh + **am / is / are**. Ijobiy javobda qisqa shakl ishlatilmaydi: Yes, I **am** («Yes, I'm» emas).

sentences.text: Are you tired? — Yes, **I am**.
Is it cold outside? — No, **it isn't**.
Are your neighbours friendly? — Yes, **they are**.
Is Dilnoza at home? — No, **she's not**. She's at work.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza uydami? — Yo'q, **uyda emas**. U ishda.

sentences.text: Am I in your way? — No, **you aren't**.
Excuse me, are you Mr Brown? — Yes, **I am**.
Is the museum free for children? — Yes, **it is**.
Are Tom and Sarah from London? — No, **they aren't**. They're from Leeds.
sentences.translation: Tom bilan Sara Londondanmi? — Yo'q, **Londondan emas**. Ular Lidsdan.

sentences.text: Madina, is your phone on? — No, **it's not**. The battery is dead.
sentences.translation: Madina, telefoning yoniqmi? — Yo'q, **yoniq emas**. Quvvati tugagan.

sentences.text: Sorry, is this your bag? — Yes, **it is**. Thank you!
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu sumka sizniki? — Ha, **meniki**. Rahmat!

examples.title: No, **it isn't**. It's ... — negative answers
examples.description: Inkor qisqa javob ikki xil: No, it **isn't** = No, it**'s not**; No, they **aren't** = No, they**'re not**. Ko'pincha undan keyin to'g'ri ma'lumot aytiladi: No, it isn't. It's Friday.

sentences.text: Is it Tuesday today? — No, **it isn't**. It's Wednesday.
Are you from Bukhara? — No, **I'm not**. I'm from Khiva.
Is the soup hot? — No, **it's not**. It's cold.
James, are those your glasses? — No, **they aren't**. They're Emma's.
sentences.translation: Jeyms, anavi ko'zoynak senikimi? — Yo'q, **meniki emas**. Emmaniki.

sentences.text: Is your sister a nurse? — No, **she isn't**. She's a doctor.
Are the tickets in your pocket? — No, **they're not**.
Am I wrong? — No, **you aren't**. You're absolutely right.
sentences.translation: Men noto'g'rimanmi? — Yo'q, **noto'g'ri emassiz**. Mutlaqo haqsiz.

sentences.text: Mr Karimov, is the meeting at ten? — No, **it isn't**. It's at eleven.
sentences.translation: Janob Karimov, majlis soat o'ndami? — Yo'q, **o'nda emas**, o'n birda.

sentences.text: Are Bekzod and Aziz cousins? — No, **they aren't**. They're brothers.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bilan Aziz amakivachchami? — Yo'q, **amakivachcha emas**, aka-uka.

sentences.text: So is the hotel near the sea? — No, **it's not**, but it's near a lake.
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, mehmonxona dengiz yaqinidami? — Yo'q, **dengiz yaqinida emas**, lekin ko'l yaqinida.

examples.title: **What** / **Where** / **Who** + is / are
examples.description: So'roq so'zi + **be** + ega: **Where is** ...? **What are** ...? **Who is** ...? So'zlashuvda is qisqaradi: **where's**, **what's**, **who's**.

sentences.text: **What's** your surname, please?
**Where are** my keys?
**Who's** the man in the blue shirt?
Excuse me, **where's** the nearest bus stop?
**What's** in that big box?
**Who are** your best friends at school?
**Where are** the children? — They're in the garden.
Dilnoza, **what's** your favourite subject?
**Who's** at the door? — It's the postman.
And **where's** your hotel — in the centre or near the airport?

examples.title: **How**, **how old**, **how much**, **what time**, **why**
examples.description: Boshqa so'roq so'zlari: **how** (qanday? qalay?), **how old** (necha yoshda?), **how much** (qancha turadi?), **what time** (soat nechada?), **what colour** (qanaqa rangda?), **why** (nega?).

sentences.text: **How are** you today? — Fine, thanks.
Bekzod, **how old is** your daughter now?
**How much are** these oranges?
**Why are** you angry with me?
**What time is** your flight to Istanbul?
**What colour are** her eyes? — They're green.
Excuse me, **how much is** a ticket to Samarkand?
Sarah, **why is** your phone off?
**How's** your new job? — Great, but I'm very busy.
sentences.translation: Yangi ishing **qalay**? — Zo'r, lekin juda bandman.

sentences.text: Tell me, **how far is** the airport from the city centre?

examples.title: **Where** are you **from**? — prepositions at the end
examples.description: O'zbekchada qo'shimcha so'roq so'zining o'ziga qo'shiladi (Qayer**dan**siz?), inglizchada esa predlog savol oxirida qoladi: **Where** ... **from**? **Who** ... **for**? **What** ... **about**?

sentences.text: **Where are** you **from**? — I'm from Fergana.
**Where's** your teacher **from**?
**Who's** this present **for**?
**What's** this film **about**?
**Who are** these flowers **for**? — They're for Mum.
Emma, **what's** your new book **about**?
**What is** Samarkand famous **for**?
**Who are** you **with** — your friends or your family?
sentences.translation: **Kim bilansiz** — do'stlaringiz bilanmi yoki oilangiz bilanmi?

sentences.text: These students are very friendly. **Where are** they **from**?
Sorry, **who is** this message **from**? There's no name.

examples.title: Dialogue: the first day at a language school
examples.description: Tanishuv suhbati: ha / yo'q savollari, so'roq so'zli savollar va qisqa javoblar bir joyda.

sentences.text: — Hi! **Are** you new here?
— Yes, **I am**. It's my first day.
— Welcome! I'm Sarah. **What's** your name?
— My name's Madina. **Is** this room five?
— Yes, **it is**. **Where are** you from, Madina?
— **I'm** from Uzbekistan, from Tashkent. And you?
— I'm from Manchester. **Are** you a student?
— No, **I'm not**. I'm a nurse. **Is** our teacher nice?
— Yes, **she is**. She's great, but very strict!
sentences.translation: — Ha, **yaxshi**. Juda zo'r, lekin juda talabchan!

sentences.text: — Thanks! And **what time is** the break?

examples.title: Mixed: questions about people and places
examples.description: Mustahkamlash: ha / yo'q savollari, so'roq so'zli savollar, qisqa va to'liq javoblar aralash.

sentences.text: **Is** Bukhara an old city? — Yes, **it is**. It's very old.
sentences.translation: Buxoro qadimiy **shaharmi**? — Ha, **qadimiy**, juda eski shahar.

sentences.text: **How old are** you, Aziz? — I'm fifteen.
**Where's** the lift? — It's on the right, next to the stairs.
**Are** you and your brother twins? — No, **we aren't**.
**What's** the capital of Scotland? — It's Edinburgh.
**Who's** your favourite singer, James?
Mum, **why are** all the windows open? It's so cold!
sentences.translation: Oyi, hamma derazalar **nega** ochiq? Juda sovuq-ku!

sentences.text: **Is** the restaurant expensive? — No, **it isn't**. The prices are quite low.
sentences.translation: Restoran **qimmatmi**? — Yo'q, **qimmat emas**. Narxlari ancha past.

sentences.text: **How much is** the room per night? — It's fifty pounds.
sentences.translation: Xona bir kechaga **qancha turadi**? — Ellik funt.

sentences.text: **Are** your parents from Tashkent too, or **are** they from Khorezm?
